findings.title: NoData result is unconditionally overwritten
findings.body: In pkg/expr/sql_command.go Execute(), when frame.Rows() == 0 rsp.Values is set to mathexp.NoData and then unconditionally overwritten on the next lines with mathexp.TableData. The empty-result branch is dead, so callers never see NoData for SQL expressions and always get an empty table instead.

findings.title: enableSqlExpressions always returns false and adds nil-toggle panic risk
findings.body: In pkg/expr/reader.go enableSqlExpressions() computes enabled as negated flag then returns false on both branches, so it always disables SQL. It also newly dereferences h.features.IsEnabledGlobally on the SQL path which previously did not touch feature toggles, so a nil or missing FeatureToggles where SQL previously parsed will now panic instead of returning an error.
